title: cyperus fuligineus var. calcicola
intro: Cyperus fuligineus var. calcicola, commonly known as a type of sedge, is a plant species in the family Cyperaceae. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions, including inflammation, fever, and respiratory issues. The health benefits of Cyperus fuligineus var. calcicola are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant, such as sesquiterpenes and flavonoids, are responsible for its medicinal effects.
